mechanism_narrative: The Federal Funds rate at or below 0.1% signals ultra-accommodative monetary policy, compressing discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when FEDFUNDS <=0.1%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 10% signals severe economic shock, triggering aggressive policy responses that produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE >10.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint condition of unemployment rate >10% and industrial production index <90 signals severe economic contraction, prompting policy interventions that yield positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE >10.0 AND INDPRO <90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the post-pandemic recovery regime (unemployment rate <15% and industrial production index >90), S&P 500 forward returns are positive over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of instances when UNRATE <15.0 AND INDPRO >90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production index falling below 90 signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when INDPRO <90.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts (HOUST) below 800 thousand units signals weakening real estate market, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in >60% of instances when HOUST <800.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
